Upgrade from business to first class by Qantas/Emirates for my husband and myself on two legs of a return trip to Italy. Travelled privately to Italy in September-October 2013; paid for return business class airfares; seats double booked on 24 September outward journey and upgraded to first class Sydney to Dubai (business Dubai to Rome); also upgraded to first class on return journey Rome to Dubai on October 6 (business Dubai to Sydney).

Upgrade from business to first class by Qantas/Emirates for my husband and myself on two legs of a return trip to Italy. Travelled privately to Italy in September-October 2013; paid for return business class airfares; seats double booked on 24 September outward journey and upgraded to first class Sydney to Dubai (business Dubai to Rome); also upgraded to first class on return journey Rome to Dubai on October 6 (business Dubai to Sydney).

Travel to Israel funded by the Australia/Israel and Jewish Affairs Council. From 29 March to 5 April 2014, study tour of Israel and the West Bank organised and funded by AIJAC. AIJAC paid for return Business airfare Sydney to Tel Aviv; member paid return Economy airfare Canberra to Sydney. AIJAC also paid accommodation in Jerusalem and Tel Aviv, meals and transport throughout the study tour.

Upgrade to business class on Virgin flight from Adelaide to Canberra. On 24 April 2014, upgraded from Economy to Business on Flight VA580 from Adelaide to Canberra; did not request an upgrade, asked to be returned to Economy but too late before take off; once seat belt sign was turned off request accommodated and stayed in Economy for the remainder of the flight.

items.entity_name: Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office
items.description: As co-chair of the Hong Kong Parliamentary Friendship Group, from 17 to 21 August 2014, undertook a study tour of Hong Kong. The study tour was organised and paid for by the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office and covered a return business class flight (international legs), a return economy class flight (domestic legs from-to Canberra), accommodation, transport and meals in the hotel.
Conference attendance: From 30 March – 1 April 2015 I attended the ASPI 2015 International Conference 'Australia's Future Surface Fleet' including conference dinner as a guest of ASPI.

items.entity_name: Government of the United Arab Emirates
items.description: Visit to UAE: part of the Australian parliamentary visit to the United Arab Emirates from 17 – 22 April 2015 as a guest of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and the Government of the United Arab Emirates. The Government of the UAE provided business class return flights from Sydney, transfers, meals and accommodation for the duration of the visit.

Conference attendance: From 9 – 15 September 2015 attended the Australia Africa Dialogue in Zambia at the invitation of the Australian Strategic Policy Institute. ASPI provided economy domestic return flights, business class international return flights, transfers, meals, accommodation and hospitality for the duration of the dialogue.

items.entity_name: Australia India Institute at the University of Melbourne
items.description: Conference attendance: From 24 – 28 October 2015 attended the inaugural Australia India Leadership Dialogue in Delhi at the invitation of the Australia India Institute at the University of Melbourne. The Australia India Institute provided an economy domestic flight from Canberra to Melbourne and business class international flights from Melbourne to Delhi. It also provided transfers, meals, accommodation and hospitality for the duration of the dialogue.

Conference attendance: From 29 October – 5 November 2015 attended the inaugural Beersheba Dialogue in Tel Aviv at the invitation of the Australian Strategic Policy Institute. ASPI provided business class international flights from Delhi to Tel Aviv and Tel Aviv to Sydney, and an economy domestic flight from Sydney to Canberra. ASPI also provided transfers, meals, accommodation and hospitality for the duration of the dialogue.

items.entity_name: Gates Foundation / Save the Children Australia
items.description: Visit to Cambodia: took part in a delegation to Cambodia to review Australian aid investment from 17 – 23 January 2016. The delegation was funded by the Gates Foundation and organised by Save the Children Australia. The Gates Foundation through Save the Children Australia funded return economy domestic and international airfares from Canberra to Cambodia, internal flights, transfers, meals, accommodation and hospitality for the duration of the trip.
